basic_info.description: Unmatched location and value! This South Beach penthouse faces south with 180-degree city views & rooftop wraparound cityscape vistas. Recently upgraded with resurfaced floors throughout, upgraded lighting fixtures, a brand new silk-blend window treatment, fresh paint, & new balcony flooring. It also features a relatively new Miele washer/dryer in the unit. Approx. 1,100 sqft of open space allows creating a home office or extra sleeping quarters. The chef's kitchen offers stainless steel appliances & opens to a large balcony perfect for entertaining. The flexible floor plan includes 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, & seamless indoor-outdoor living. The building just completed an over $600K structural /waterproofing upgrades, fully paid for provides peace of mind. The low HOA of $600 covers 1 parking, storage, water, and trash. With a Walk Score of 95, Transit Score of 96, and Bike Score of 92, it's ideal for city living, a pied-a-terre, or investment in one of SF's most exciting neighborhoods.
